The '''''Sky Shredder''''' was a [[Repulsorcraft/Legends|repulsorcraft]] and flying barge on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vandin]] used to play [[Huttball/Legends|Huttball]] around [[3630 BBY]].
